RadiusComment: Radius in blocks that the radial menu will scan around you for dropped items.
InstantComment: false = use cooldown; true = instant craft
ItemCooldownComment: This is the cooldown System. It combines three values below to calculate the final cooldown. If your recipe requires 4 boards and a hammer, it will add 4 X NormalItemCooldown and 1 X ToolCooldown to the final cooldown. Then that sum is multiplied by the batch size you choose with the multi-crafting system.
NormalItemCooldownComment: This will add the value above in seconds for each normal resources needed for your recipe.
ToolCooldownComment: This will add the value above in seconds for each tool needed for the recipe.
ContainerCooldownComment: This will add the value above in seconds for each liquid container needed for the recipe.
